in_marathi.name: Amitav
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amitav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Amitav is a Sanskrit and Bengali name derived from the word 'amita', which means immeasurable. It is a name for a wise and radiant individual who possesses the knowledge and light to bring prosperity and abundance.
